mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4% signals an easing monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where unemployment rate is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a growing economy, which leads to increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where housing starts increase by 10% YoY and unemployment rate decreases by 1% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates an increase in supply, which leads to decreased prices and increased demand, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply indicate an easing monetary policy, which leads to increased borrowing and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where federal funds rate decreases by 1% and money supply increases by 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A high employment rate and a low unemployment rate indicate a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where employment rate is above 95% and unemployment rate is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index indicates decreased demand, which leads to decreased prices and increased demand, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in deflationary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
